title: Högutdelarna att äga när det stormar – ”Kvalité belönas”
summary_md:
# Högutdelarna att äga när det stormar – ”Kvalité belönas”

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-10-07  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Börslunch (EFN) with Hanna Lindbo of Ålandsbanken and Carl-Henrik Söderberg of Nordnet looks at how rising interest rates will affect the market. Small caps and real estate are expected to keep losing out, while banks and quality dividend payers with strong balance sheets should hold up well. The guest is positive on Volvo, Autoliv, Skanska and the banks. Other topics are NCC's roughly SEK 8bn sale of its industrial business, the SEB CEO's sudden exit, Volvo Cars' EX60 production problems and Clas Ohlson's strong sales.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 VOLV-B — Volvo | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest (Ålandsbanken) positive: fleet replacement need, high freight rates, EPA27 clarity possibly lifting orders in Nov-Dec, fiscal stimulus.

#### Reasoning

Hanna Lindbo says 'vi är positiva till Volvo'. The stock is ~20% below its August high on sector weakness. Drivers: an aging fleet, profitable hauliers, delayed orders while EPA27 emissions rules are unclear (expected to be set around Oct/Nov, which could give a pop in Nov-Dec), and European fiscal stimulus. Weak ACT data is seen as timing-related.

#### Sell Triggers

- if European recovery stalls on energy prices or ECB hikes
- if higher financing and diesel costs suppress truck orders
- if Chinese electric truck competition gains traction in Europe

> *"Men vi är positiva till Volvo. Vi ser att det finns... Vi tror att de underliggande drivarna finns där."*

---

### 🟢 ALIV-SDB — Autoliv | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest likes Autoliv: dominant market share, growth with Chinese OEMs, more safety content per car, ~10% total shareholder yield.

#### Reasoning

Structural drivers include more safety content per vehicle and growth in China and India. Autoliv is gaining share with Chinese OEMs, which avoids the China risk other suppliers face. It has a 45% global share, ~3% dividend yield and ~6% annual buybacks. Near-term risk: the full-year margin guide of 10.5-11% implies ~14% in Q4.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin expectations are cut because Q4 does not deliver the implied ~14% margin
- if global light vehicle production weakens further

> *"Så du har nästan 10 % total yield i den där. Så vi gillar den."*

---

### 🟢 SKA-B — Skanska | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest likes Skanska's construction business: record order intake, datacenter demand, better profitability, net cash. Preferred over NCC.

#### Reasoning

Hanna Lindbo argues the market wrongly groups Skanska with rate-sensitive property stocks. Construction has record orders (~SEK 300bn YTD), datacenter tailwinds and better project selection and margins. US commercial property writedowns are a risk, but net cash and good occupancy mean no forced sales. Asked 'Skanska or NCC', she said 'vi gillar Skanska'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if large writedowns hit the US commercial property portfolio
- if higher rates cut investment and construction orders

> *"jag tycker att den starka byggraden Rörelsen överväger till det positiva."*

---

### 🟡 SEB-A — SEB | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest owns SEB; the CEO's departure does not change the view. Banks favoured: 7-8% earnings growth plus ~5% yield in the current rate environment.

#### Reasoning

The guest's fund owns SEB and says Torgeby's exit does not change the case, since there are internal candidates ready. On banks broadly, she is positive: 7-8% earnings growth and ~5% dividend yield, with net interest income not under heavy pressure. Little valuation upside is expected, so returns should come from earnings growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- if interest rates fall sharply and squeeze net interest income
- if CEO succession disrupts operations

> *"Nej, det påverkar inte krisen för oss."*

---

### 🟠 NCC-B — NCC | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Industrial business sale (~SEK 7bn cash vs 17bn mcap) seen as strategically right, with potentially higher dividends ahead. Guest still prefers Skanska.

#### Reasoning

The guest calls the divestment good and strategically correct, and expects 'all else equal' a higher dividend from the cash. The stock reacted only ~5%, less than she expected. She did not recommend buying NCC and preferred Skanska.

#### Sell Triggers

- if proceeds are not returned to shareholders
- if the remaining construction business weakens

> *"Jag tror att det är bra för NCC att det är strategiskt riktigt på sikt"*

---

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Strong sales again: +12% organic, many quarters above the 5% organic growth target. The host calls it impressive.

#### Reasoning

Host comment only, with no explicit recommendation. Clas Ohlson keeps beating its ≥5% organic growth target (+12% organic, +19% total), set against a tough consumer backdrop.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth falls below the 5% target

> *"Nej, men otroligt imponerande. Skillnad på konsumentaktier och konsumentaktier."*

---
